reference_description: A dropper bottle with a frosted blush-pink cylindrical glass body that has a gently rounded shoulder transitioning to a short neck. The closure assembly consists of a tall rose-gold/champagne metallic collar screwed onto the neck, topped by a dark plum/mauve rubber pipette bulb that is rounded-dome shaped at the top. The bottle carries 'BBROSE Rose Damascena Night Repair Oil' branding. The overall silhouette is a wide, squat cylinder with elegant proportions.
output_description: A flat/cartoon-style synthetic render showing a dropper bottle with a nearly rectangular body (very little shoulder curvature, nearly straight sides going almost to the top edge), a small stepped beige/cream collar segment, and a dark purple-grey truncated-rectangular/trapezoidal bulb shape at the top. The bulb reads as a flat pentagon or trapezoid rather than a rounded dome. The body is white-cream with no frosted translucency or branding. Proportions are taller and narrower than the reference, and the overall rendering style is 2D flat with no materials depth.
top_component_observed_shape: Flat trapezoidal/pentagonal dark shape — not a rounded dome bulb

component_semantics.evidence: The dark element at the top is positioned where a pipette bulb would be, but its shape is a flat trapezoid/pentagon rather than the expected rounded hemisphere of the reference's plum dome bulb.

visual_findings: Bulb shape is a flat pentagon/trapezoid, not the rounded dome seen in the reference.
Collar is a plain beige stepped block with no metallic rose-gold finish.
Body is rectangular with near-straight sides and minimal shoulder curvature; reference has a clearly rounded cylindrical shoulder.
No frosted blush-pink translucency; render is flat opaque white-cream.
Render is 2D flat-art style with no material depth, reflections, or surface finish.
No branding or label present on the body.
Overall proportions are taller and narrower than the squat cylindrical reference.
Previous iteration (Image 3) had a similar structural problem with bulb shape (flame/spike form); current iteration changes it to a flat trapezoid but still does not achieve the rounded dome.
